title: Tenant deletion after a stated grace period, verified empty
description:
Outcome: Implements the deletion half of PPY-8e6c06. After cancellation and the grace period (owner decision 11 default: 30 days, export available throughout), one workflow removes every row (through tenant indexes), every object under tenants/<t>/ and sites/<t>/, KVS host entries and certificates, the Cyclotron store, vectors and the title-word entries, then runs a verification that finds nothing and writes a deletion receipt (counts only). Backups age out on their own schedule, which the terms state.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new src/papyrus_content/tenant_delete.py, a workflow function, TenantDomain cleanup, docs and terms text.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-deletion.feature):
Scenario: Deletion leaves nothing behind
    Given "alpha" was cancelled 30 days ago
    When deletion runs
    Then a fresh export of "alpha" is empty, its hosts answer 404 and "beta" is unchanged

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-e882ee, PPY-d7274f. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-8e6c06.

Testing: Behave; the adversarial suite re-run after deletion.
Rollout: Shared stack; every deletion of a real tenant is logged and reported to the operator.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: deleting the wrong tenant. Mitigation: deletion takes the tenant id and its display name, refuses an active tenant, and runs a dry run that must be confirmed.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
